title: Director, Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations
text:
We are looking for someone to join our growing team to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, CNC manufacturing turn-key machine tool solutions. This role combines technical leadership, project management, customer engagement, and team development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for taking large, turnkey manufacturing projects from initial customer requirements through engineering development, testing, implementation, and final acceptance. You will lead projects involving a wide range of CNC technologies. You will coordinate internal engineering resources, customers, machine-tool and tooling vendors, partners, and other suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Director of Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations will be responsible for establishing project priorities, managing expectations, identifying risks, resolving technical and organizational issues, and ensuring successful project outcomes. While this is a leadership and project-management position, a strong understanding of CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing processes, machine tools, and controls is required. The successful candidate should be comfortable engaging deeply with technical teams and making informed decisions on complex manufacturing challenges when required.

**About Empire Dynamics Machinery, LLC**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 10-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers that collectively wants to see change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director will be accountable for ensuring these responsibilities are fulfilled, whether through direct involvement, delegation to existing team members, or the development of additional team capabilities as the business grows. The role requires both hands-on leadership and the ability to build scalable processes, teams, and organizational capabilities.

**Project Management**

* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary CNC manufacturing projects from project initiation through customer acceptance.
* Establish project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, and priorities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, resource requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate engineering resources across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish project priorities and ensure engineering activities remain aligned with customer and business objectives.
* Lead regular project status meetings and communicate project health to customers and internal leadership.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, technical issues, and customer requests.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet defined technical and customer requirements.
* Develop project documentation, status reports, action plans, and lesson-learned documentation.
* Establish and improve project management processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.

**CNC Process Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical direction for the development of comprehensive CNC manufacturing processes.
* Oversee development of CAM programming, tooling strategies, fixturing, workholding, process parameters, and setup documentation.
* Review and approve process plans and CAM development strategies.
* Guide engineers in analyzing critical machining operations for feasibility, efficiency, and optimization.
* Oversee development of stage models, setup sheets, work instructions, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Coordinate tooling suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Support development of process outlines to distribute engineering work effectively across the team.
* Provide technical leadership during machine setup, program verification, and customer program runoff.
* Maintain awareness of current CNC machining technologies and manufacturing practices.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop CNC manufacturing engineers and technical staff.
* Assign project responsibilities based on team capabilities, project requirements, and priorities.
* Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project execution, documentation, and communication.
* Provide technical and professional mentorship to developing engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and standardization across projects.
* Help establish career-development paths and technical competency expectations for the engineering team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Oversee the development of relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine-tool builders, software providers, and other technical partners.
* Manage vendor activities associated with project tooling, fixturing, machine capabilities, and software requirements.
* Establish technical requirements and deliverables for external suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance against project schedules and requirements.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical or project-related vendor issues.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to effectively lead highly specialized CNC engineering projects. Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* NX CAM and CNC programming
* CAM programming and toolpath development
* CNC machine tools, including milling, turning, mill-turn, HMC, VTC, grinding, and specialty machines
* CNC machine controls, macros, probing, and advanced machine functions
* CAD modeling
* Cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and machining strategies
* Fixture design and workholding
* Manufacturing process development
* CNC machine commissioning and runoff
* NX CAM templates and productivity environments
* Teamcenter, MRL, and machining data libraries
* Software development or scripting
* Manufacturing engineering and machine-shop operations

The Director is not expected to personally perform every technical task. Rather, the position requires the ability to understand complex technical issues, establish direction, evaluate solutions, allocate resources, and ensure the engineering team delivers the appropriate solution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, manufacturing, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Strong project planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred**

Experience with:

* Managing complex, customer-facing manufacturing projects.
* Using NX CAM and Siemens manufacturing software.
* Post-processors and CNC controls.
* Leading engineering or technical teams.
* Software development or technical product development.
* Working directly with machine-tool builders, tooling manufacturers, or manufacturing suppliers.
* Developing manufacturing processes for multiple CNC machine types.
* Project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Customer acceptance testing and technical implementation projects.

Knowledge of:

* Variety of CNC controllers and willing to learn new controller types
* CNC programming techniques and process
* Feeds, speeds, and cutting tool applications
* Geometry and trigonometry
* Fixture specifications, design, and work holding.

A strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated proficiency interpreting drawing and specification requirements

**Leadership Characteristics**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ownership: Takes responsibility for project outcomes from initiation through completion.
* Leadership: Provides clear direction while empowering technical experts to perform their best work.
* Customer focus: Understands customer objectives and translates them into practical engineering solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies, machines, software, and manufacturing processes.
* Communication: Clearly communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and expectations.
* Organization: Can manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams.
* Problem solving: Approaches difficult technical and organizational challenges systematically.
* Continuous improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve both customer solutions and internal processes.
* Accountability: Establishes measurable expectations and follows through on commitments.

**Location**

Albany, New York or Remote.

**Travel Requirements**

20% travel to customer sites, partners, or other business-related travel.
